title: Goblin Town Shop
body:
The Goblin Town is a series of stores located in the Acidland Caves.

Description

The Town is mainly used as a hub full of passive Goblins that will not attack the player. Located directly behind the Goblin Arena.

To gain access to the Goblin Town you must prove yourself worthy by talking to the Goblin located within the arena. He will give the player a Quest to kill the Skeleton King and retrieve the Acid Crown. After you complete the quest upon returning to the Goblin, it will initiate the Goblin Trials which is a challenge that consists of eliminating multiple waves of enemies in order to gain access to the town.

The Goblins sell items that are mostly related to improving the player's ability to defeat mobs from the Acidlands.

The Goblin Town is found by going in the Acidland Caves and following the path relative to the entrance from the main Acidlands entrance. Following the route will lead to a visible inner island inside the cave which crossing over will reveal the goblin arena tucked back in the inner part of the cave.
